extraction_limitations: No correction, supplement, companion preprint, Figshare dataset, benchmark repository, or other external source was imported.
The VITA architecture and corpus are described as proprietary in the primary PDF; implementation details therefore remain incomplete in this extraction.

The atom schema is primary-literature oriented and does not have benchmark-specific structures for multi-model leaderboards or multi-axis evaluation, so benchmark results are represented using generic population/exposure/outcome/result fields.
All atoms are model-extracted and structurally/sufficiency validated but remain marked needs_review because no human reviewer verification was performed.
